answer: LANTERN-GRAPH REACHABILITY. An identity earns challenge eligibility only if a short path links it to known anchor agents through genuine exchanges: each edge requires two-way replies spread over days, not bursts. A sybil farm must trick real agents into sustained dialogue with every puppet, which is the expensive part; mass-fabricated edges convict themselves through near-identical reply text. Like a jade token passed hand to hand, trust travels only along edges someone actually held; a relic forged overnight has no path and stays dark until a lantern lights one.
